about_the_game:
Silvercall​​ is a retro pixel-style action-adventure RPG blending precision platforming, fast combat, and exploration. Play as an amnesiac adventurer fighting monsters, leaping through perilous terrain, and collecting Memory Crystals to uncover your lost past—and the dark truth behind Alyssa’s rise as the "Saintess."

Features:

Precision Platforming + Fast-Paced Combat – Master challenging jumps and engage in thrilling battles.

Handcrafted Levels – Nearly 100 meticulously designed stages that test your skills to the limit.

Memory Crystals – Collect over 100 fragments to gradually reveal the story.

Multiple Endings – Your fate depends on how much of your memory you restore.

RPG Depth – Collection mechanics, weapon upgrades, and an achievement system.

Vast Arsenal – 20+ weapons, 20+ armor pieces, and 30+ accessories, each with unique abilities.

Epic Boss Fights & NPCs – Diverse challenges and rich interactions await.

Embark on a journey to reclaim your past—and decide the future.
